skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature and role of public speaking
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the essence and role of public speaking activities, principles for successful presentations, and methods for planning and preparing for public speaking events.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing and applying public speaking skills
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze issues encountered during preparation and delivery of speeches, and apply knowledge of public speaking skills to develop effective plans for real-life speaking engagements.
Analyze and coordinate team efforts in research, preparation, and presentation activities.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Using foreign languages in research and presentations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and use foreign language materials in research and preparation for public speaking activities, and use foreign languages effectively during presentations and listening to speeches.
